## Protocol & Model Refinements
#47 replaces `dict[str, Any]` with typed-dynamic primitives, using `Mapping[str, JsonValue]` for open payloads and `TypedDict` for known structures like `ProducerMessage`. It enforces JSON-safety and documents constraints (`max_keys=100`, `max_depth=5`). #51 adds the `ProtocolHandlerContract` interface, defining `handler_id`, `descriptor`, `capability_inputs`, and `execution_constraints` for type-safe handler contracts. #69 codifies `ProtocolEventPublisher` semantics, documenting topic override precedence and partition key handling, and adds 18 unit tests to prevent interface drift.

## Delegation & Routing Logic
#3413 sends completed delegations to the acceptance judge by subscribing to the delegate-skill completed terminal and publishing a render request. It moves request models to `omnimarket.models` to avoid cross-node reach-in. #3289 fixes the routing reducer to mirror the dispatched credential path, ensuring `api_key_env` eligibility matches `api_key_ref` resolution. #2841 declares `no_escalation` on the delegate-skill request, passing it only when true and requiring a `backend_id` pin. #3161 carries `caller_lane` and `session_id` on the delegate-skill terminal, omitting them when `None` to avoid dead-lettering.

## CI & Release Automation
#307 adds a `sync_only` input to `release.yml`, skipping publishing steps to allow retrying only the idempotent main sync. #1717 allows `occ-preflight` to accept a dependency-pin-only outcome, preventing `stamp_absent` failures for version bumps. #3655 moves the shard-plan partition proof to the typecheck job to reduce integration-guard runtime. #1562 gates `test-parallel` and `tests-integration` behind non-draft PR state, adding `ready_for_review` to trigger types. #1713 adds the missing `call-occ-autobind` caller to `omnibase_core`. #363 moves the CodeQL reusable workflow reference to `omnibase_core`. #314 bumps the `public-repo-hygiene-reusable.yml` workflow.

## Runtime & Compute Nodes
#1655 fixes a def-B single-emit terminal to be recognized as the current run's own, resolving correlation ID mismatches in `LocalRuntimeBusAdapter`. #3635 registers `node_morning_ground_state_orchestrator` in `pyproject.toml`. #3805 adds an automation-liveness watchdog compute node for verdicts and failure episodes. #3051 projects lane container memory events into `lab_container_memory_window`. #3274 corrects the savings file shape and regenerates the relation inventory.

## Security & Validation
#966 implements Gate 4, banning silent `except` blocks via AST checks. #1462 updates the no-hardcoded-ip check to scan multiple roots (`src`, `scripts`), closing a scope gap. #1590 restricts OCC repo matching to the exact canonical name, preventing misclassification of same-named repos in other orgs.

## Platform & UI Contracts
#1255 adds UI contract primitives and `EnumEmptyStateReason` for the Contract-Driven UI Platform. #1252 bumps `omnibase_core` to v0.45.0 to propagate the deletion of `ModelOnexEnvelope`. #1324 removes three grandfathered URL-authority reads. #1208 backmerges the main guard into the dev promotion lane. #3466 moves redelivery tests into the Golden Chain Suite. #3710 updates M4 landing configs to be idempotent and fact-based.
